# emuctl

> Shared pool of Android emulators for people and AI agents: FIFO lease queue, MCP server, holder-only adb, APK store, Prometheus metrics. Lease a device, use it, release it.

Start with docs/quickstart.md. Key rules: always release (run and MCP do it for you), hold one lease at a time, keep it alive with heartbeats, and set up app state inside your own lease.

## Docs

- [Index and rules](docs/README.md): what to read, terms, the rules that matter
- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): `emuctl run -- CMD`, `acquire`, MCP loop
- [APKs](docs/apks.md): `-apk`, and the APK store keyed by native fingerprint (`-apk-key`, `apk put`)
- [MCP](docs/mcp.md): tools, arguments, the agent loop
- [CLI](docs/cli.md): all commands, `run` flags, exit codes
- [HTTP API](docs/api.md): endpoints, lease lifecycle with curl, status codes
- [Operating](docs/operating.md): config, release modes, health checks, sizing, metrics
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptom, cause, fix

## Optional

- [README](README.md): full project overview, install, security notes, metric list
